content_harvesting.sublines: Direct C-SQLite3 in Swift 6 for Sub-Millisecond Offline Ski Routing
talking_points: CirqueDatabase links directly against system libsqlite3 with SQLITE_OPEN_READONLY | SQLITE_OPEN_NOMUTEX instead of pulling in SwiftData or CoreData.
A dictionary-backed OpaquePointer cache resets compiled SQLite bytecode via sqlite3_reset and sqlite3_clear_bindings for 0.041 ms adjacency reads.
PRAGMA query_only = ON rejects writes at the SQLite engine boundary, and deinit finalizes every cached statement with zero pointer leaks across 50 lifecycle iterations.
